propositions: Location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) remain at their paths; dependency inversion allows jira_family/ to define contracts without importing adapters/jira/.
Jira-family-general symbols (identity.py, pure classifier from probe.py, value-map literals, sanitizers) relocate to adapters/jira_family/ with public names and are re-imported by Cloud adapter.

Sanitizer contracts (_sanitize_description, _sanitize_comment) receive injected dependencies (RichTextCodec, comment-limit contract) rather than importing pinned modules, preventing circular dependency.

RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES remains in adapters/jira/probe.py as Cloud's configured value; classify_probe_response becomes a Cloud-side bound function that delegates to the relocated classifier with the status set injected.

Import graph constraint enforced by persistent test: no module under adapters/jira/ or adapters/jira_datacenter/ may import from adapters/jira_family/, and jira_family/ may not import from either concrete adapter.
Deliberate observable change: deleted ticket status maps to Jira 'Done' (was invalid 'Deleted'); ACLI path retains .title() fallback for already-Jira names and unmapped keys.
